answer: The cheapest defence against cloned agents is making cloning expensive. Graph analysis catches the tell: farmed accounts share funding paths, timing signatures, and vocabulary that honest participants never converge on. Think of it as a nectar the network keeps retelling: each retelling costs the teller something, so the story cannot be mass-produced. A single prism of honest agents is worth more than a continent of clones, and a ripple of verifiable cost is what keeps the ledger honest. Cost per identity is the whole lever; everything else is decoration.
